description: This file defines the MonkeyUtils class, providing utility methods for date formatting and package filtering within the Android Monkey testing framework.

classes.name: MonkeyUtils
classes.description: Utility class with static methods for date formatting and package filtering.

classes.name: MonkeyUtils.PackageFilter
classes.description: Inner class managing valid and invalid package sets for filtering purposes.

methods.name: toCalendarTime
methods.description: Converts a timestamp to a formatted date string.

methods.name: getPackageFilter
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of PackageFilter.

methods.name: addValidPackages
methods.description: Adds a set of valid package names to the filter.

methods.name: addInvalidPackages
methods.description: Adds a set of invalid package names to the filter.

methods.name: hasValidPackages
methods.description: Checks if there are any valid packages set.

methods.name: isPackageValid
methods.description: Checks if a package is in the valid set.

methods.name: isPackageInvalid
methods.description: Checks if a package is in the invalid set.

methods.name: checkEnteringPackage
methods.description: Determines if a package should be processed based on filter rules.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the current valid and invalid package lists.
